title: Slack launches Slack Code, adding dedicated, project-specific channels that let teams collaborate with AI coding agents "like teammates" across all Slack plans (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: Slack launches Slack Code, adding dedicated, project-specific channels that let teams collaborate with AI coding agents “like teammates” across all Slack plans — Slack Code provides a dedicated open space for teams to collaborate with AI agents.
contentText:
Jess Weatherbed / The Verge :

Slack launches Slack Code, adding dedicated, project-specific channels that let teams collaborate with AI coding agents “like teammates” across all Slack plans   —  ﻿Slack Code provides a dedicated open space for teams to collaborate with AI agents.
